#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build field_values.json for California form SC-100 (Plaintiff's Claim and ORDER to
Go to Small Claims Court) from a structured case.json.

Applies the SC-100 filling rules deterministically (which box answers which item,
item 10 from the claim amount, single date vs. date range, mirrored captions, fields
the plaintiff must never fill) and resolves every field ID and checkbox value against
the actual PDF, so a revised form fails loudly instead of filling the wrong box.

Requires: Python >= 3.10, pypdf >= 5.1 (+ cryptography for the encrypted court PDF).
Imports scripts/pdf_forms.py from the same folder.

Usage (run from the skill root):
  python3 scripts/sc100_build.py <blank_sc100.pdf> <case.json> <field_values.json> \
      [--date-format %Y-%m-%d] [--amount-style plain|comma|cents]
Then: python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py fill <blank.pdf> <field_values.json> <out.pdf>
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys
from datetime import datetime

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from pdf_forms import get_field_info, open_reader  # noqa: E402

P1 = "SC-100[0].Page1[0]."
P2 = "SC-100[0].Page2[0]."
P3 = "SC-100[0].Page3[0]."
P4 = "SC-100[0].Page4[0]."
PL = P2 + "List1[0].Item1[0]."
DF = P2 + "List2[0].item2[0]."

# Fields the plaintiff never fills (court/clerk use, or form buttons). Listed for the report.
COURT_ONLY = [P1 + "CaptionRight[0].CN[0].CaseNumber[0]", P2 + "PxCaption[0].CaseNumber[0]",
              P3 + "PxCaption[0].CaseNumber[0]", P4 + "PxCaption[0].CaseNumber[0]",
              P1 + "Order[0].*Trial*", "SC-100[0].Page5[0].*NeedHelp*", "SC-100[0].Page6[0].*NeedHelpSpanish*",
              "SC-100[0].#pageSet[0].MPLast[0].{Print,Save,Reset}[0]"]

REQUIRED = ["plaintiffs", "defendants", "claim_amount", "why_owed", "how_calculated", "asked_to_pay",
            "venue", "attorney_fee_dispute", "public_entity", "more_than_12_claims", "filing_date"]

DATE_FORMATS = ["%Y-%m-%d", "%Y/%m/%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%m-%d-%Y", "%m/%d/%y", "%B %d, %Y", "%B %d %Y",
                "%b %d, %Y", "%b %d %Y", "%d %B %Y", "%d %b %Y", "%B %Y"]


class BuildError(Exception):
    pass


def norm_date(value, fmt, label):
    if value in (None, ""):
        return None
    s = re.sub(r"(\d)(st|nd|rd|th)\b", r"\1", str(value).strip())
    s = re.sub(r"\bSept\b", "Sep", s, flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)
    for f in DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(s, f).strftime(fmt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    raise BuildError(f"{label}: cannot parse date {value!r}; give it as YYYY-MM-DD")


def norm_amount(value, style):
    s = str(value).replace("$", "").replace(",", "").strip()
    try:
        num = float(s)
    except ValueError:
        raise BuildError(f"claim_amount: {value!r} is not a number")
    if style == "cents":
        text = f"{num:.2f}"
    elif style == "comma":
        text = f"{num:,.2f}" if num != int(num) else f"{int(num):,}"
    else:
        text = s if "." in s and num != int(num) else str(int(num)) if num == int(num) else s
    return text, num


def text(v):
    return "" if v is None else str(v).strip()


def build(case, info, date_fmt, amount_style):
    missing = [k for k in REQUIRED if k not in case or case[k] in (None, "", [])]
    if not (case.get("incident_date") or case.get("period_start")):
        missing.append("incident_date or period_start/period_end")
    if missing:
        raise BuildError("case.json is missing required keys: " + ", ".join(missing))

    by_id = {f["field_id"]: f for f in info}
    values = []  # (field_id, value, description)
    notes = []

    def put(fid, value, desc):
        if value in (None, ""):
            return
        if fid not in by_id:
            raise BuildError(f"field `{fid}` ({desc}) is not in this PDF; the SC-100 revision differs. "
                             "Fill this item via the generic fillable-form path.")
        values.append((fid, value, desc))

    def check(fid, desc):
        f = by_id.get(fid)
        if not f or "checked_value" not in f:
            raise BuildError(f"checkbox `{fid}` ({desc}) not found or has no checked value in this PDF")
        put(fid, f["checked_value"], desc)

    def yes_no(base, answer, item):
        check(f"{base}[0]" if answer else f"{base}[1]", f"Item {item}: {'Yes' if answer else 'No'}")

    # ---- item 1: plaintiffs (two slots on the form; more -> SC-100A)
    plaintiffs = case["plaintiffs"]
    names = [text(p.get("name")) for p in plaintiffs]
    caption = ", ".join(n for n in names if n)
    put(P2 + "PxCaption[0].Plaintiff[0]", caption, "Caption: plaintiff names (page 2)")
    # Pages 3-4 captions are read-only mirrors of page 2 in the form's XFA logic.
    put(P3 + "PxCaption[0].Plaintiff[0]", caption, "Caption: plaintiff names (page 3 mirror)")
    put(P4 + "PxCaption[0].Plaintiff[0]", caption, "Caption: plaintiff names (page 4 mirror)")
    for i, p in enumerate(plaintiffs[:2], start=1):
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffName{i}[0]", text(p.get("name")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} name")
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffPhone{i}[0]", text(p.get("phone")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} phone")
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffAddress{i}[0]", text(p.get("street")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} street")
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffCity{i}[0]", text(p.get("city")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} city")
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffState{i}[0]", text(p.get("state")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} state")
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffZip{i}[0]", text(p.get("zip")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} zip")
        m = p.get("mailing") or {}
        if text(m.get("street")) and text(m.get("street")).lower() != text(p.get("street")).lower():
            put(f"{PL}PlaintiffMailingAddress{i}[0]", text(m.get("street")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} mailing street")
            put(f"{PL}PlaintiffMailingCity{i}[0]", text(m.get("city")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} mailing city")
            put(f"{PL}PlaintiffMailingState{i}[0]", text(m.get("state")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} mailing state")
            put(f"{PL}PlaintiffMailingZip{i}[0]", text(m.get("zip")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} mailing zip")
        put(f"{PL}EmailAdd{i}[0]", text(p.get("email")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} email")
    if len(plaintiffs) > 2:
        check(PL + "Checkbox1[0]", "Item 1: more than two plaintiffs (attach SC-100A)")
        notes.append("More than two plaintiffs: list plaintiffs 3+ on form SC-100A.")
    if case.get("plaintiff_fictitious_business"):
        check(PL + "Checkbox2[0]", "Item 1: fictitious business name (attach SC-103)")
        notes.append("Attach form SC-103 (fictitious business name).")
    if case.get("plaintiff_payday_lender"):
        check(PL + "Checkbox3[0]", "Item 1: plaintiff is a licensee / deferred deposit originator")

    # ---- item 2: defendant (one slot; more -> SC-100A)
    defendants = case["defendants"]
    d = defendants[0]
    put(DF + "DefendantName1[0]", text(d.get("name")), "Item 2: defendant name")
    put(DF + "DefendantPhone1[0]", text(d.get("phone")), "Item 2: defendant phone")
    put(DF + "DefendantAddress1[0]", text(d.get("street")), "Item 2: defendant street")
    put(DF + "DefendantCity1[0]", text(d.get("city")), "Item 2: defendant city")
    put(DF + "DefendantState1[0]", text(d.get("state")), "Item 2: defendant state")
    put(DF + "DefendantZip1[0]", text(d.get("zip")), "Item 2: defendant zip")
    m = d.get("mailing") or {}
    if text(m.get("street")) and text(m.get("street")).lower() != text(d.get("street")).lower():
        put(DF + "DefendantMailingAddress1[0]", text(m.get("street")), "Item 2: defendant mailing street")
        put(DF + "DefendantMailingCity1[0]", text(m.get("city")), "Item 2: defendant mailing city")
        put(DF + "DefendantMailingState1[0]", text(m.get("state")), "Item 2: defendant mailing state")
        put(DF + "DefendantMailingZip1[0]", text(m.get("zip")), "Item 2: defendant mailing zip")
    agent = d.get("agent") or {}
    if text(agent.get("name")):
        put(DF + "DefendantName2[0]", text(agent.get("name")), "Item 2: agent for service name")
        put(DF + "DefendantJob1[0]", text(agent.get("job_title")), "Item 2: agent job title")
        put(DF + "DefendantAddress2[0]", text(agent.get("street")), "Item 2: agent street")
        put(DF + "DefendantCity2[0]", text(agent.get("city")), "Item 2: agent city")
        put(DF + "DefendantState2[0]", text(agent.get("state")), "Item 2: agent state")
        put(DF + "DefendantZip2[0]", text(agent.get("zip")), "Item 2: agent zip")
    if len(defendants) > 1:
        check(DF + "Checkbox4[0]", "Item 2: more than one defendant (attach SC-100A)")
        notes.append("More than one defendant: list defendants 2+ on form SC-100A.")
    if case.get("defendant_military"):
        check(DF + "Checkbox5[0]", "Item 2: a defendant is on active military duty")
        notes.append("The form has no fillable box for the military defendant's name; write it by hand after the checkbox.")

    # ---- item 3: claim
    amount_text, amount = norm_amount(case["claim_amount"], amount_style)
    put(P2 + "List3[0].PlaintiffClaimAmount1[0]", amount_text, "Item 3: amount claimed ($ is printed)")
    why = text(case["why_owed"])
    put(P2 + "List3[0].Lia[0].FillField2[0]", why, "Item 3a: why the defendant owes the money")
    single = norm_date(case.get("incident_date"), date_fmt, "incident_date")
    start = norm_date(case.get("period_start"), date_fmt, "period_start")
    end = norm_date(case.get("period_end"), date_fmt, "period_end")
    if start and end and start == end and not single:
        single, start, end = start, None, None
    if single:
        put(P3 + "List3[0].Lib[0].Date1[0]", single, "Item 3b: date it happened")
    else:
        if not end:
            raise BuildError("period_start given without period_end (or give incident_date)")
        put(P3 + "List3[0].Lib[0].Date2[0]", start, "Item 3b: date started")

Applies the SC-100 filling rules deterministically (which box answers which item,
item 10 from the claim amount, single date vs. date range, mirrored captions, fields
the plaintiff must never fill) and resolves every field ID and checkbox value against
the actual PDF, so a revised form fails loudly instead of filling the wrong box.

Requires: Python >= 3.10, pypdf >= 5.1 (+ cryptography for the encrypted court PDF).
Imports scripts/pdf_forms.py from the same folder.

Usage (run from the skill root):
  python3 scripts/sc100_build.py <blank_sc100.pdf> <case.json> <field_values.json> \

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys
from datetime import datetime

P2 = "SC-100[0].Page2[0]."

PL = P2 + "List1[0].Item1[0]."
DF = P2 + "List2[0].item2[0]."

              P3 + "PxCaption[0].CaseNumber[0]", P4 + "PxCaption[0].CaseNumber[0]",
              P1 + "Order[0].*Trial*", "SC-100[0].Page5[0].*NeedHelp*", "SC-100[0].Page6[0].*NeedHelpSpanish*",
              "SC-100[0].#pageSet[0].MPLast[0].{Print,Save,Reset}[0]"]

            "venue", "attorney_fee_dispute", "public_entity", "more_than_12_claims", "filing_date"]

DATE_FORMATS = ["%Y-%m-%d", "%Y/%m/%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%m-%d-%Y", "%m/%d/%y", "%B %d, %Y", "%B %d %Y",
                "%b %d, %Y", "%b %d %Y", "%d %B %Y", "%d %b %Y", "%B %Y"]


class BuildError(Exception):
    pass


def norm_date(value, fmt, label):
    if value in (None, ""):
        return None
    s = re.sub(r"(\d)(st|nd|rd|th)\b", r"\1", str(value).strip())
    s = re.sub(r"\bSept\b", "Sep", s, flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)

        raise BuildError(f"claim_amount: {value!r} is not a number")

P3 = "SC-100[0].Page3[0]."
P4 = "SC-100[0].Page4[0]."
PL = P2 + "List1[0].Item1[0]."
DF = P2 + "List2[0].item2[0]."

# Fields the plaintiff never fills (court/clerk use, or form buttons). Listed for the report.
COURT_ONLY = [P1 + "CaptionRight[0].CN[0].CaseNumber[0]", P2 + "PxCaption[0].CaseNumber[0]",
              P3 + "PxCaption[0].CaseNumber[0]", P4 + "PxCaption[0].CaseNumber[0]",
              P1 + "Order[0].*Trial*", "SC-100[0].Page5[0].*NeedHelp*", "SC-100[0].Page6[0].*NeedHelpSpanish*",
              "SC-100[0].#pageSet[0].MPLast[0].{Print,Save,Reset}[0]"]

REQUIRED = ["plaintiffs", "defendants", "claim_amount", "why_owed", "how_calculated", "asked_to_pay",
            "venue", "attorney_fee_dispute", "public_entity", "more_than_12_claims", "filing_date"]

DATE_FORMATS = ["%Y-%m-%d", "%Y/%m/%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%m-%d-%Y", "%m/%d/%y", "%B %d, %Y", "%B %d %Y",
                "%b %d, %Y", "%b %d %Y", "%d %B %Y", "%d %b %Y", "%B %Y"]


class BuildError(Exception):
    pass


def norm_date(value, fmt, label):
    if value in (None, ""):
        return None
    s = re.sub(r"(\d)(st|nd|rd|th)\b", r"\1", str(value).strip())
    s = re.sub(r"\bSept\b", "Sep", s, flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)
    for f in DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(s, f).strftime(fmt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    raise BuildError(f"{label}: cannot parse date {value!r}; give it as YYYY-MM-DD")


def norm_amount(value, style):
    s = str(value).replace("$", "").replace(",", "").strip()
    try:
        num = float(s)
    except ValueError:
        raise BuildError(f"claim_amount: {value!r} is not a number")
    if style == "cents":
        text = f"{num:.2f}"
    elif style == "comma":
        text = f"{num:,.2f}" if num != int(num) else f"{int(num):,}"
    else:
        text = s if "." in s and num != int(num) else str(int(num)) if num == int(num) else s
    return text, num


def text(v):
    return "" if v is None else str(v).strip()


def build(case, info, date_fmt, amount_style):
    missing = [k for k in REQUIRED if k not in case or case[k] in (None, "", [])]
    if not (case.get("incident_date") or case.get("period_start")):
        missing.append("incident_date or period_start/period_end")
    if missing:
        raise BuildError("case.json is missing required keys: " + ", ".join(missing))

    by_id = {f["field_id"]: f for f in info}
    values = []  # (field_id, value, description)
    notes = []

    def put(fid, value, desc):
        if value in (None, ""):
            return
        if fid not in by_id:
            raise BuildError(f"field `{fid}` ({desc}) is not in this PDF; the SC-100 revision differs. "
                             "Fill this item via the generic fillable-form path.")
        values.append((fid, value, desc))

    def check(fid, desc):
        f = by_id.get(fid)
        if not f or "checked_value" not in f:
            raise BuildError(f"checkbox `{fid}` ({desc}) not found or has no checked value in this PDF")
        put(fid, f["checked_value"], desc)

    def yes_no(base, answer, item):
        check(f"{base}[0]" if answer else f"{base}[1]", f"Item {item}: {'Yes' if answer else 'No'}")

    # ---- item 1: plaintiffs (two slots on the form; more -> SC-100A)
    plaintiffs = case["plaintiffs"]
    names = [text(p.get("name")) for p in plaintiffs]
    caption = ", ".join(n for n in names if n)
    put(P2 + "PxCaption[0].Plaintiff[0]", caption, "Caption: plaintiff names (page 2)")
    # Pages 3-4 captions are read-only mirrors of page 2 in the form's XFA logic.
    put(P3 + "PxCaption[0].Plaintiff[0]", caption, "Caption: plaintiff names (page 3 mirror)")
    put(P4 + "PxCaption[0].Plaintiff[0]", caption, "Caption: plaintiff names (page 4 mirror)")
    for i, p in enumerate(plaintiffs[:2], start=1):
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffName{i}[0]", text(p.get("name")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} name")
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffPhone{i}[0]", text(p.get("phone")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} phone")
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffAddress{i}[0]", text(p.get("street")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} street")
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffCity{i}[0]", text(p.get("city")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} city")
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffState{i}[0]", text(p.get("state")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} state")
        put(f"{PL}PlaintiffZip{i}[0]", text(p.get("zip")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} zip")
        m = p.get("mailing") or {}
        if text(m.get("street")) and text(m.get("street")).lower() != text(p.get("street")).lower():
            put(f"{PL}PlaintiffMailingAddress{i}[0]", text(m.get("street")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} mailing street")
            put(f"{PL}PlaintiffMailingCity{i}[0]", text(m.get("city")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} mailing city")
            put(f"{PL}PlaintiffMailingState{i}[0]", text(m.get("state")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} mailing state")
            put(f"{PL}PlaintiffMailingZip{i}[0]", text(m.get("zip")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} mailing zip")
        put(f"{PL}EmailAdd{i}[0]", text(p.get("email")), f"Item 1: plaintiff {i} email")
    if len(plaintiffs) > 2:
        check(PL + "Checkbox1[0]", "Item 1: more than two plaintiffs (attach SC-100A)")
        notes.append("More than two plaintiffs: list plaintiffs 3+ on form SC-100A.")
    if case.get("plaintiff_fictitious_business"):
        check(PL + "Checkbox2[0]", "Item 1: fictitious business name (attach SC-103)")
        notes.append("Attach form SC-103 (fictitious business name).")
    if case.get("plaintiff_payday_lender"):
        check(PL + "Checkbox3[0]", "Item 1: plaintiff is a licensee / deferred deposit originator")

    # ---- item 2: defendant (one slot; more -> SC-100A)
    defendants = case["defendants"]
    d = defendants[0]
    put(DF + "DefendantName1[0]", text(d.get("name")), "Item 2: defendant name")
    put(DF + "DefendantPhone1[0]", text(d.get("phone")), "Item 2: defendant phone")
    put(DF + "DefendantAddress1[0]", text(d.get("street")), "Item 2: defendant street")
    put(DF + "DefendantCity1[0]", text(d.get("city")), "Item 2: defendant city")
    put(DF + "DefendantState1[0]", text(d.get("state")), "Item 2: defendant state")
    put(DF + "DefendantZip1[0]", text(d.get("zip")), "Item 2: defendant zip")
    m = d.get("mailing") or {}
    if text(m.get("street")) and text(m.get("street")).lower() != text(d.get("street")).lower():
        put(DF + "DefendantMailingAddress1[0]", text(m.get("street")), "Item 2: defendant mailing street")
        put(DF + "DefendantMailingCity1[0]", text(m.get("city")), "Item 2: defendant mailing city")
        put(DF + "DefendantMailingState1[0]", text(m.get("state")), "Item 2: defendant mailing state")
        put(DF + "DefendantMailingZip1[0]", text(m.get("zip")), "Item 2: defendant mailing zip")
    agent = d.get("agent") or {}
    if text(agent.get("name")):
        put(DF + "DefendantName2[0]", text(agent.get("name")), "Item 2: agent for service name")
        put(DF + "DefendantJob1[0]", text(agent.get("job_title")), "Item 2: agent job title")
        put(DF + "DefendantAddress2[0]", text(agent.get("street")), "Item 2: agent street")
        put(DF + "DefendantCity2[0]", text(agent.get("city")), "Item 2: agent city")
        put(DF + "DefendantState2[0]", text(agent.get("state")), "Item 2: agent state")
        put(DF + "DefendantZip2[0]", text(agent.get("zip")), "Item 2: agent zip")
    if len(defendants) > 1:
        check(DF + "Checkbox4[0]", "Item 2: more than one defendant (attach SC-100A)")
        notes.append("More than one defendant: list defendants 2+ on form SC-100A.")
    if case.get("defendant_military"):
        check(DF + "Checkbox5[0]", "Item 2: a defendant is on active military duty")
        notes.append("The form has no fillable box for the military defendant's name; write it by hand after the checkbox.")

    # ---- item 3: claim
    amount_text, amount = norm_amount(case["claim_amount"], amount_style)
    put(P2 + "List3[0].PlaintiffClaimAmount1[0]", amount_text, "Item 3: amount claimed ($ is printed)")
    why = text(case["why_owed"])
    put(P2 + "List3[0].Lia[0].FillField2[0]", why, "Item 3a: why the defendant owes the money")
    single = norm_date(case.get("incident_date"), date_fmt, "incident_date")
    start = norm_date(case.get("period_start"), date_fmt, "period_start")
    end = norm_date(case.get("period_end"), date_fmt, "period_end")
    if start and end and start == end and not single:
        single, start, end = start, None, None
    if single:
        put(P3 + "List3[0].Lib[0].Date1[0]", single, "Item 3b: date it happened")
    else:
        if not end:
            raise BuildError("period_start given without period_end (or give incident_date)")
        put(P3 + "List3[0].Lib[0].Date2[0]", start, "Item 3b: date started")
        put(P3 + "List3[0].Lib[0].Date3[0]", end, "Item 3b: through")
    how = text(case["how_calculated"])
    put(P3 + "List3[0].Lic[0].FillField1[0]", how, "Item 3c: how the amount was calculated")
    if len(why) > 500 or len(how) > 350:
        notes.append("3a/3c text is long and may overflow its box; consider shortening or set need_more_space.")
    if case.get("need_more_space"):
        check(P3 + "List3[0].Checkbox1[0]", "Item 3: need more space (attach MC-031)")
        notes.append('Attach one sheet or form MC-031 titled "SC-100, Item 3".')

    # ---- item 4: asked defendant to pay
    asked = bool(case["asked_to_pay"])
    yes_no(P3 + "List4[0].Item4[0].Checkbox50", asked, 4)
    if not asked:
        if not text(case.get("why_not_asked")):
            raise BuildError("asked_to_pay is false: why_not_asked is required (item 4 explanation)")
        put(P3 + "List4[0].Item4[0].FillField2[0]", text(case["why_not_asked"]), "Item 4: why not asked")

    # ---- item 5: venue
    venue = text(case["venue"]).lower()
    letters = {"a": "Lia", "b": "Lib", "c": "Lic", "d": "Lid", "e": "Lie"}
    if venue not in letters:
        raise BuildError(f"venue must be one of a, b, c, d, e; got {venue!r}")
    check(f"{P3}List5[0].{letters[venue]}[0].Checkbox5cb[0]", f"Item 5{venue}: venue basis")
    if venue == "e":
        if not text(case.get("venue_other")):
            raise BuildError("venue 'e' requires venue_other (specify)")
        put(P3 + "List5[0].Lie[0].FillField55[0]", text(case["venue_other"]), "Item 5e: other (specify)")

    # ---- item 6: zip of the place in 5 (only if known)
    put(P3 + "List6[0].item6[0].ZipCode1[0]", text(case.get("venue_zip")), "Item 6: zip code of venue place")

    # ---- item 7: attorney-client fee dispute
    fee = bool(case["attorney_fee_dispute"])
    yes_no(P3 + "List7[0].item7[0].Checkbox60", fee, 7)
    if fee and case.get("had_arbitration"):
        check(P3 + "List7[0].item7[0].Checkbox11[0]", "Item 7: had arbitration (attach SC-101)")
        notes.append("Attach form SC-101 (attorney fee dispute after arbitration).")

    # ---- item 8: public entity
    public = bool(case["public_entity"])
    yes_no(P3 + "List8[0].item8[0].Checkbox61", public, 8)
    if public:
        filed = norm_date(case.get("public_claim_filed_date"), date_fmt, "public_claim_filed_date")
        if filed:
            check(P3 + "List8[0].item8[0].Checkbox14[0]", "Item 8: a claim was filed with the entity")
            put(P3 + "List8[0].item8[0].Date4[0]", filed, "Item 8: date the claim was filed")
        else:
            notes.append("Suing a public entity requires filing a written claim with it first; no filed date given.")

    # ---- item 9: more than 12 claims in 12 months
    yes_no(P4 + "List9[0].Item9[0].Checkbox62", bool(case["more_than_12_claims"]), 9)

    # ---- item 10: computed from the amount
    yes_no(P4 + "List10[0].li10[0].Checkbox63", amount > 2500, 10)
    if amount > 10000:
        notes.append("Claim exceeds $10,000 (the individual small-claims limit; $6,250 for some plaintiffs). Verify eligibility.")

    # ---- signature block (item 11 has no field)
    filing = norm_date(case["filing_date"], date_fmt, "filing_date")
    put(P4 + "Sign[0].Date1[0]", filing, "Signature: date")
    put(P4 + "Sign[0].PlaintiffName1[0]", names[0], "Signature: plaintiff printed name")
    if len(plaintiffs) > 1:
        put(P4 + "Sign[0].Date2[0]", filing, "Signature: second plaintiff date")
        put(P4 + "Sign[0].PlaintiffName2[0]", names[1], "Signature: second plaintiff printed name")

    # ---- page 1 court box: only when the case statement names it
    put(P1 + "CaptionRight[0].County[0].CourtInfo[0]", text(case.get("court_name_address")), "Page 1: court name and street address")
    put(P1 + "CaptionRight[0].CN[0].CaseName[0]", text(case.get("case_name")), "Page 1: case name")

    out = [{"field_id": fid, "description": desc, "page": by_id[fid]["page"], "value": v} for fid, v, desc in values]
    return out, notes


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("pdf")
    ap.add_argument("case")
    ap.add_argument("out")
    ap.add_argument("--date-format", default="%Y-%m-%d", help="strftime format for every date (default %%Y-%%m-%%d)")
    ap.add_argument("--amount-style", choices=["plain", "comma", "cents"], default="plain",
                    help="plain: 1500 / 1500.50; comma: 1,500; cents: 1500.00")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    with open(a.case) as f:
        case = json.load(f)
    info = get_field_info(open_reader(a.pdf))
    if not any(f["field_id"].startswith("SC-100[0]") for f in info):
        sys.exit("ERROR: this PDF is not form SC-100; use the generic fillable-form path in SKILL.md")
    try:
        values, notes = build(case, info, a.date_format, a.amount_style)
    except BuildError as e:
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: {e}")
    with open(a.out, "w") as f:
        json.dump(values, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    for v in values:
        shown = v["value"] if len(str(v["value"])) < 70 else str(v["value"])[:67] + "..."
        print(f"p{v['page']}  {v['description']:<48} {shown}")
    print(f"\nWrote {len(values)} field values to {a.out}")
    print("Left empty on purpose (court/clerk only): case numbers, trial date/time/department/address, "
          "clerk date/signature, page 5-6 advisor boxes, Print/Save/Reset buttons.")
    for n in notes:
        print("NOTE:", n)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Non-fillable PDF forms: text-annotation workflow

Use only when `pdf_forms.py check` reports `"fillable": false` (e.g. a scanned or flattened
copy of the form). Perform every step; skipping the visual checks puts text in the wrong place.
Run all commands from the skill root.

## Step 1: Visual analysis

`python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py render <file.pdf> <img_dir>` writes `page_N.png` per page (longest side ≤ 1000 px).

Examine each image and find every place the user should enter data. For each text field record
two boxes in **image pixel coordinates**: the label box and the entry box. They MUST NOT intersect;
the entry box covers only the writable area (usually right of, above, or below the label) and must be
tall and wide enough for its text.

Common structures:

*Label inside box* — `┌ Name: ________ ┐` → entry starts right of "Name:" and runs to the box edge.

*Label before line* — `Email: ________` → entry is above the line, full line width.

*Label under line* — line with "Name" printed below → entry is above the line, full line width
(typical for signature and date fields).

*Label above line* — "Please enter any special requests:" with a line below → entry runs from the
bottom of the label down to the line, full line width.

*Checkboxes* — `Are you a US citizen? Yes □  No □`
- Target the small square (□), which may sit left or right of its label.
- Keep the label text ("Yes", "No") out of the entry box; the entry box covers ONLY the square.

## Step 2: fields.json and validation images

```json
{
  "pages": [
    {"page_number": 1, "image_width": 772, "image_height": 1000}
  ],
  "form_fields": [
    {
      "page_number": 1,
      "description": "The user's last name should be entered here",
      "field_label": "Last name",
      "label_bounding_box": [30, 125, 95, 142],
      "entry_bounding_box": [100, 125, 280, 142],
      "entry_text": {"text": "Johnson", "font_size": 14, "font_color": "000000"}
    },
    {
      "page_number": 1,
      "description": "Checkbox that should be checked if the user is over 18",
      "field_label": "Yes",
      "label_bounding_box": [100, 525, 132, 540],
      "entry_bounding_box": [140, 525, 155, 540],
      "entry_text": {"text": "X"}
    }
  ]
}
```

- Boxes are `[left, top, right, bottom]` in image pixels; `image_width/height` are the rendered PNG sizes.

fill an SC-100 item by hand through the generic path, or when checking a filled PDF.
All IDs start with `SC-100[0].`; that prefix is omitted below. Checkbox checked value in
parentheses; unchecked is always `/Off`. **Who** = P (plaintiff fills when the facts exist),
C (court/clerk only — always leave empty), M (read-only mirror of the page-2 field).

| Item | Field ID (without `SC-100[0].`) | Meaning | Who |
|---|---|---|---|
| p1 | `Page1[0].CaptionRight[0].County[0].CourtInfo[0]` | "Superior Court of California, County of" + court street address | P, only if the case statement names the court |

---
name: sc100-form-filling
description: Fill the California Small Claims form SC-100 (Plaintiff's Claim and ORDER to Go to Small Claims Court) from a plain-language case description, and fill other PDF court forms — fillable (AcroForm/XFA) or flat/scanned — with pypdf. Use when asked to complete, fill in, or prepare an SC-100 or similar court/government PDF form from case facts, leaving court-only and unmentioned fields empty and writing dates in a requested format.
compatibility: Python >= 3.10; pip packages pypdf>=5.1, cryptography (opens the encrypted court PDF), Pillow (validation images), pdf2image (optional; falls back to poppler-utils `pdftoppm`). All present in the task container (pypdf 5.1.0, fillpdf pulls in pdf2image/Pillow, poppler-utils installed).
---

# SC-100 Small Claims Form Filling

## Trigger When

1. A task says to fill California form SC-100 / "Plaintiff's Claim and ORDER to Go to Small Claims Court" (e.g. `/root/sc100-blank.pdf`) from a case description.
2. A small-claims plaintiff describes who they are suing, for how much, and why, and wants the claim form prepared.
3. Any PDF form (court, government, intake) must be filled from free-text facts with only the necessary fields set.
4. A PDF form has no fillable fields and text must be placed visually.

## Purpose

Turns a case description into a correctly filled SC-100: it extracts the plaintiff/defendant/claim facts into a fixed `case.json`, answers the form's yes/no and venue questions as typed decisions, and lets a script apply the SC-100 rules (which checkbox answers which item, item 10 from the amount, single date vs. period, page-3/4 caption mirrors, court-only fields left blank) against the real field IDs before filling with pypdf. It also carries the general fillable and non-fillable PDF form workflows for forms other than SC-100.

## Before the first script

Check `python3 --version` (≥ 3.10) and `python3 -c "import pypdf, cryptography, PIL"`; for rendering also `python3 -c "import pdf2image"` or `which pdftoppm`. Name everything missing before continuing. Run every command from this skill's root folder; write working files (case.json, field_values.json, images) to a scratch dir such as `/tmp/sc100/`, never into the skill folder.

## Workflow

- [ ] 1. Inspect the PDF (script)
- [ ] 2. Answer the case questions (decision)
- [ ] 3. Write `case.json` (client task)
- [ ] 4. Build and validate field values (script)
- [ ] 5. Fill (script)
- [ ] 6. Verify (script + look)

### 1. Inspect — `execution`

```bash
python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py check /root/sc100-blank.pdf
```
Prints JSON `{fillable, field_count, pages, encrypted, has_xfa, form_id}`. Branch:
- `form_id == "SC-100"` → continue with steps 2–6.
- `fillable: true`, other form → [Generic fillable form](#generic-fillable-form).
- `fillable: false` → follow [references/non-fillable-forms.md](references/non-fillable-forms.md).

### 2. Case questions — `decision`

Input: the case description. Answer all in one pass; reconsider any close call.

```yaml
venue:
  type: choice
  instructions: Which item-5 box says why the claim is filed at this courthouse? Use the plaintiff's stated reason first; if none is stated, pick what the facts support.
  criteria:
    a: Where the defendant lives or does business; where the plaintiff's property was damaged; where the plaintiff was injured; or where a contract was made, signed, performed, or broken by the defendant (or where the defendant lived/did business then). Ordinary person-to-person disputes, deposits, loans between individuals.
    b: Buyer or lessee's location, for an offer or contract for personal, family, or household goods, services, or loans (CCP 395(b)).
    c: Buyer's location, for a retail installment contract such as a credit card.
    d: Buyer's location or where the vehicle is garaged, for a vehicle finance sale.
    e: None of the above; requires venue_other text.
incident_timing:
  type: choice
  instructions: How does the description date the event for item 3b?
  criteria:
    single_date: One specific date ("on 2025-03-02") -> incident_date.
    period: A range ("from X until Y", "between", "since X through Y") -> period_start + period_end.
asked_to_pay:
  type: noul
  instructions: Did the plaintiff ask the defendant to pay (in person, in writing, text, or phone) before suing?
  criteria:
    true: Any request is described — calls, texts, letters, emails, even unanswered.
    false: The description says no request was made; then why_not_asked is required.
attorney_fee_dispute:
  type: noul
  instructions: Is the claim an attorney-client fee dispute? False unless the claim is about a lawyer's fees.
more_than_12_claims:
  type: noul
  instructions: Has the plaintiff filed more than 12 other small claims in California in the last 12 months? "First time suing" or no mention means false.
public_entity:
  type: noul
  instructions: Is the defendant a public entity (city, county, state agency, school district)? Individuals and private businesses are false.
defendant_is_organization:
  type: noul
  instructions: Is the defendant a corporation, LLC, or public entity, so an agent for service belongs in item 2? Individuals are false.
flags:
  type: noul
  instructions: Answer each separately (default false unless the description says so) — plaintiff_fictitious_business (plaintiff uses a DBA), plaintiff_payday_lender, defendant_military (active duty), need_more_space (3a/3c will not fit), had_arbitration (only with a fee dispute).
```

A false positive on any noul checks a box the plaintiff never claimed; when unsure and the description is silent, answer false. Item 10 (> $2,500) is not a question: the script computes it.

### 3. Write `case.json` — `client_task`

Copy [assets/case_template.json](assets/case_template.json) to the scratch dir and fill it from the description and step 2:

- Copy names, phones, emails, and street addresses **verbatim** (do not reformat `4125886066` into `(412) 588-6066`). Split each address into `street`, `city`, `state` (two letters), `zip`.
- `mailing`: `null` unless a different mailing address is given (object with street/city/state/zip).
- `agent` (only if `defendant_is_organization`): `{"name","job_title","street","city","state","zip"}` from the description, else `null`.
- `claim_amount`: the number as stated. Dates: any common format; the script normalises them.
- `why_owed` (3a) and `how_calculated` (3c): one or two plain factual sentences built only from the description — what the defendant did or failed to do, the agreement/document, and where the number comes from (e.g. "Security deposit of $1500 stated in the signed roommate sublease contract; no deductions."). Do not invent facts, court costs, or interest.
- `venue_zip`: the zip of the place behind the venue choice (e.g. the defendant's zip for "where defendant lives"); empty if unknown.
- `filing_date`: the date the user says to file/sign with.
- `court_name_address`, `case_name`: fill **only** if the description states them; otherwise `""`. Do not infer a county from a city.
- Several plaintiffs/defendants: list all; the script fills the first two plaintiffs / first defendant and checks the SC-100A boxes.

### 4. Build — `execution`

```bash
python3 scripts/sc100_build.py /root/sc100-blank.pdf /tmp/sc100/case.json /tmp/sc100/field_values.json --date-format %Y-%m-%d
```
Set `--date-format` to the task's requested format (`xxxx-xx-xx` → `%Y-%m-%d`, `mm/dd/yyyy` → `%m/%d/%Y`); default is `%Y-%m-%d`. `--amount-style plain|comma|cents` gives `1500` / `1,500` / `1500.00` (default `plain`, matching how amounts are usually stated).
It prints one line per field it will set plus `NOTE:` lines (attachments needed, overflow risk, > $10,000). Read the plan against the description; an `ERROR:` names the missing key or bad value — fix `case.json` and rerun. If it says a field is not in this PDF (a different form revision), load [references/sc100-fields.md](references/sc100-fields.md) and fill that item through the generic path.

### 5. Fill — `execution`

```bash
python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py fill /root/sc100-blank.pdf /tmp/sc100/field_values.json /root/sc100-filled.pdf
```
Validates every ID, page, and checkbox value before writing; on `ERROR:` nothing is written. It opens the encrypted source, writes an unencrypted copy, sets NeedAppearances, and drops the XFA layer (otherwise Acrobat shows the blank XFA form); `--keep-xfa` skips that. `NOTE: ... read-only` for the page-3/4 captions is expected.

### 6. Verify — `execution`

```bash
python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py dump /root/sc100-filled.pdf
```
Lists every non-empty field. Confirm: each value matches the description; exactly one of each Yes/No pair is set; no case number, trial, clerk, page-5/6, or second-plaintiff field appears unless warranted; dates use the requested format. Optionally `python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py render /root/sc100-filled.pdf /tmp/sc100/img` and look at pages 2–4 (renderers that ignore NeedAppearances may show blanks; trust `dump`).

## Generic fillable form

For fillable PDFs other than SC-100 (or SC-100 items the builder cannot map):
1. `python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py extract <in.pdf> /tmp/form/field_info.json` — list of `{field_id, page, rect [l,b,r,t] in PDF points (y=0 at bottom), type text|checkbox|radio_group|choice|pushbutton, checked_value/unchecked_value, radio_options[{value,rect}], choice_options[{value,text}], tooltip, read_only}`. The `tooltip` usually states the field's question.
2. `python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py render <in.pdf> /tmp/form/img` and match fields to labels (convert rects: image_x = x·W/page_width, image_y = (page_height − y)·H/page_height).
3. Write `field_values.json`: `[{"field_id": "...", "description": "...", "page": 1, "value": "..."}]`. Checkboxes take their `checked_value` (e.g. `/1`, `/On`); radio groups one of `radio_options[].value`; choices one of `choice_options[].value`. Never set push buttons; skip court-only and unmentioned fields.
4. `python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py fill <in.pdf> /tmp/form/field_values.json <out.pdf>`; fix any `ERROR:` and rerun; then `dump` to verify.

For non-form PDF work (extract text, merge, split, rotate, encrypt), read [references/pdf-general.md](references/pdf-general.md); it links [references/pdf-advanced.md](references/pdf-advanced.md).

## Gotchas

- "Only fill the necessary fields": leave empty the court-filled fields (case number everywhere, trial order block, clerk, page 5–6 advisor boxes), the second plaintiff block, mailing addresses that are not different, item-4 explanation when Yes, item-8 date when No, and the page-1 court/case-name box unless stated.
- Answer every Yes/No item (4, 7, 8, 9, 10) with exactly one box; "No" is a real answer, not an empty field.
- 3b is either the single date **or** started/through, never both.
- The `$` in item 3 is pre-printed; the value is the number only.
- Item 5a is one checkbox covering sub-reasons (1)–(4); there are no separate boxes.
- The SC-100 PDF is encrypted (empty password) and carries XFA; plain `PdfReader` works because `cryptography` is installed, but other tools (pdftk, qpdf) are not available.

- `fillable: false` → follow [references/non-fillable-forms.md](references/non-fillable-forms.md).

### 2. Case questions — `decision`

Input: the case description. Answer all in one pass; reconsider any close call.

```yaml
venue:
  type: choice
  instructions: Which item-5 box says why the claim is filed at this courthouse? Use the plaintiff's stated reason first; if none is stated, pick what the facts support.
  criteria:
    a: Where the defendant lives or does business; where the plaintiff's property was damaged; where the plaintiff was injured; or where a contract was made, signed, performed, or broken by the defendant (or where the defendant lived/did business then). Ordinary person-to-person disputes, deposits, loans between individuals.
    b: Buyer or lessee's location, for an offer or contract for personal, family, or household goods, services, or loans (CCP 395(b)).
    c: Buyer's location, for a retail installment contract such as a credit card.
    d: Buyer's location or where the vehicle is garaged, for a vehicle finance sale.
    e: None of the above; requires venue_other text.
incident_timing:
  type: choice
  instructions: How does the description date the event for item 3b?
  criteria:
    single_date: One specific date ("on 2025-03-02") -> incident_date.
    period: A range ("from X until Y", "between", "since X through Y") -> period_start + period_end.
asked_to_pay:
  type: noul
  instructions: Did the plaintiff ask the defendant to pay (in person, in writing, text, or phone) before suing?
  criteria:
    true: Any request is described — calls, texts, letters, emails, even unanswered.
    false: The description says no request was made; then why_not_asked is required.
attorney_fee_dispute:
  type: noul
  instructions: Is the claim an attorney-client fee dispute? False unless the claim is about a lawyer's fees.
more_than_12_claims:
  type: noul
  instructions: Has the plaintiff filed more than 12 other small claims in California in the last 12 months? "First time suing" or no mention means false.
public_entity:
  type: noul
  instructions: Is the defendant a public entity (city, county, state agency, school district)? Individuals and private businesses are false.
defendant_is_organization:
  type: noul
  instructions: Is the defendant a corporation, LLC, or public entity, so an agent for service belongs in item 2? Individuals are false.
flags:
  type: noul
  instructions: Answer each separately (default false unless the description says so) — plaintiff_fictitious_business (plaintiff uses a DBA), plaintiff_payday_lender, defendant_military (active duty), need_more_space (3a/3c will not fit), had_arbitration (only with a fee dispute).
```

A false positive on any noul checks a box the plaintiff never claimed; when unsure and the description is silent, answer false. Item 10 (> $2,500) is not a question: the script computes it.

### 3. Write `case.json` — `client_task`

Copy [assets/case_template.json](assets/case_template.json) to the scratch dir and fill it from the description and step 2:

- Copy names, phones, emails, and street addresses **verbatim** (do not reformat `4125886066` into `(412) 588-6066`). Split each address into `street`, `city`, `state` (two letters), `zip`.
- `mailing`: `null` unless a different mailing address is given (object with street/city/state/zip).
- `agent` (only if `defendant_is_organization`): `{"name","job_title","street","city","state","zip"}` from the description, else `null`.
- `claim_amount`: the number as stated. Dates: any common format; the script normalises them.
- `why_owed` (3a) and `how_calculated` (3c): one or two plain factual sentences built only from the description — what the defendant did or failed to do, the agreement/document, and where the number comes from (e.g. "Security deposit of $1500 stated in the signed roommate sublease contract; no deductions."). Do not invent facts, court costs, or interest.
- `venue_zip`: the zip of the place behind the venue choice (e.g. the defendant's zip for "where defendant lives"); empty if unknown.
- `filing_date`: the date the user says to file/sign with.
- `court_name_address`, `case_name`: fill **only** if the description states them; otherwise `""`. Do not infer a county from a city.
- Several plaintiffs/defendants: list all; the script fills the first two plaintiffs / first defendant and checks the SC-100A boxes.

### 4. Build — `execution`

```bash
python3 scripts/sc100_build.py /root/sc100-blank.pdf /tmp/sc100/case.json /tmp/sc100/field_values.json --date-format %Y-%m-%d
```
Set `--date-format` to the task's requested format (`xxxx-xx-xx` → `%Y-%m-%d`, `mm/dd/yyyy` → `%m/%d/%Y`); default is `%Y-%m-%d`. `--amount-style plain|comma|cents` gives `1500` / `1,500` / `1500.00` (default `plain`, matching how amounts are usually stated).
It prints one line per field it will set plus `NOTE:` lines (attachments needed, overflow risk, > $10,000). Read the plan against the description; an `ERROR:` names the missing key or bad value — fix `case.json` and rerun. If it says a field is not in this PDF (a different form revision), load [references/sc100-fields.md](references/sc100-fields.md) and fill that item through the generic path.

### 5. Fill — `execution`

```bash
python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py fill /root/sc100-blank.pdf /tmp/sc100/field_values.json /root/sc100-filled.pdf
```
Validates every ID, page, and checkbox value before writing; on `ERROR:` nothing is written. It opens the encrypted source, writes an unencrypted copy, sets NeedAppearances, and drops the XFA layer (otherwise Acrobat shows the blank XFA form); `--keep-xfa` skips that. `NOTE: ... read-only` for the page-3/4 captions is expected.

### 6. Verify — `execution`

```bash
python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py dump /root/sc100-filled.pdf
```
Lists every non-empty field. Confirm: each value matches the description; exactly one of each Yes/No pair is set; no case number, trial, clerk, page-5/6, or second-plaintiff field appears unless warranted; dates use the requested format. Optionally `python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py render /root/sc100-filled.pdf /tmp/sc100/img` and look at pages 2–4 (renderers that ignore NeedAppearances may show blanks; trust `dump`).

## Generic fillable form

For fillable PDFs other than SC-100 (or SC-100 items the builder cannot map):
1. `python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py extract <in.pdf> /tmp/form/field_info.json` — list of `{field_id, page, rect [l,b,r,t] in PDF points (y=0 at bottom), type text|checkbox|radio_group|choice|pushbutton, checked_value/unchecked_value, radio_options[{value,rect}], choice_options[{value,text}], tooltip, read_only}`. The `tooltip` usually states the field's question.
2. `python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py render <in.pdf> /tmp/form/img` and match fields to labels (convert rects: image_x = x·W/page_width, image_y = (page_height − y)·H/page_height).
3. Write `field_values.json`: `[{"field_id": "...", "description": "...", "page": 1, "value": "..."}]`. Checkboxes take their `checked_value` (e.g. `/1`, `/On`); radio groups one of `radio_options[].value`; choices one of `choice_options[].value`. Never set push buttons; skip court-only and unmentioned fields.
4. `python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py fill <in.pdf> /tmp/form/field_values.json <out.pdf>`; fix any `ERROR:` and rerun; then `dump` to verify.

For non-form PDF work (extract text, merge, split, rotate, encrypt), read [references/pdf-general.md](references/pdf-general.md); it links [references/pdf-advanced.md](references/pdf-advanced.md).

## Gotchas

- "Only fill the necessary fields": leave empty the court-filled fields (case number everywhere, trial order block, clerk, page 5–6 advisor boxes), the second plaintiff block, mailing addresses that are not different, item-4 explanation when Yes, item-8 date when No, and the page-1 court/case-name box unless stated.
- Answer every Yes/No item (4, 7, 8, 9, 10) with exactly one box; "No" is a real answer, not an empty field.
- 3b is either the single date **or** started/through, never both.
- The `$` in item 3 is pre-printed; the value is the number only.
- Item 5a is one checkbox covering sub-reasons (1)–(4); there are no separate boxes.
- The SC-100 PDF is encrypted (empty password) and carries XFA; plain `PdfReader` works because `cryptography` is installed, but other tools (pdftk, qpdf) are not available.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PDF form toolkit: inspect, extract, render, fill, verify (fillable forms) and
annotate (non-fillable forms).

Requires: Python >= 3.10, pypdf >= 5.1 (+ cryptography for encrypted PDFs),
Pillow (validation images), pdf2image or the poppler `pdftoppm` binary (render).

Usage (run from the skill root):
  python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py check <pdf>
  python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py extract <pdf> <field_info.json>
  python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py render <pdf> <out_dir> [--max-dim 1000]
  python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py fill <pdf> <field_values.json> <out.pdf> [--keep-xfa]
  python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py dump <pdf> [--all]
  python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py check-boxes <fields.json>
  python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py validation-image <page> <fields.json> <in.png> <out.png>
  python3 scripts/pdf_forms.py annotate <pdf> <fields.json> <out.pdf>
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

try:
    from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
except ImportError:
    sys.exit("ERROR: pypdf is not installed (pip install pypdf). It is required by every subcommand.")


def open_reader(path):
    reader = PdfReader(path)
    if reader.is_encrypted:
        # Court forms are commonly encrypted with an empty user password (permissions only).
        try:
            reader.decrypt("")
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            sys.exit(f"ERROR: {path} is encrypted and could not be opened with an empty password: {e}")
    return reader


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- field info
# Matches the naming used by PdfReader.get_fields and update_page_form_field_values.
def get_full_annotation_field_id(annotation):
    components = []
    while annotation:
        field_name = annotation.get("/T")
        if field_name:
            components.append(field_name)
        annotation = annotation.get("/Parent")
    return ".".join(reversed(components)) if components else None


def make_field_dict(field, field_id):
    field_dict = {"field_id": field_id}
    ft = field.get("/FT")
    if ft == "/Tx":
        field_dict["type"] = "text"
    elif ft == "/Btn":
        field_dict["type"] = "checkbox"  # radio groups handled separately
        states = field.get("/_States_", [])
        if len(states) == 2:
            # "/Off" is the unchecked value (PDF 32000-1:2008, 12.7.4.2.3); it may be first or second.
            if "/Off" in states:
                field_dict["checked_value"] = states[0] if states[0] != "/Off" else states[1]
                field_dict["unchecked_value"] = "/Off"
            else:
                print(f"WARNING: unexpected state values for checkbox `{field_id}`; its checked/unchecked "
                      "values may be wrong. If you check it, visually verify the result.")
                field_dict["checked_value"] = states[0]
                field_dict["unchecked_value"] = states[1]
    elif ft == "/Ch":
        field_dict["type"] = "choice"
        states = field.get("/_States_", [])
        field_dict["choice_options"] = [{"value": s[0], "text": s[1]} for s in states]
    else:
        field_dict["type"] = f"unknown ({ft})"
    tooltip = field.get("/TU")
    if tooltip:
        field_dict["tooltip"] = " ".join(str(tooltip).split())
    flags = int(field.get("/Ff", 0) or 0)
    if flags & 1:
        field_dict["read_only"] = True
    if ft == "/Btn" and flags & 65536:
        field_dict["type"] = "pushbutton"  # Print/Save/Reset buttons: never fill
    return field_dict


def get_field_info(reader):
    """List of fillable fields sorted by page, then top-to-bottom, then left-to-right."""
    fields = reader.get_fields() or {}
    field_info_by_id = {}
    possible_radio_names = set()
    for field_id, field in fields.items():
        # Skip containers with children, except possible radio-button parents.
        if field.get("/Kids"):
            if field.get("/FT") == "/Btn":
                possible_radio_names.add(field_id)
            continue
        field_info_by_id[field_id] = make_field_dict(field, field_id)

    # Bounding rects live in the page annotations. Radio options have one annotation
    # per choice, all sharing the parent field name.
    radio_fields_by_id = {}
    for page_index, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
        for ann in page.get("/Annots", []) or []:
            ann = ann.get_object()
            field_id = get_full_annotation_field_id(ann)
            if field_id in field_info_by_id:
                field_info_by_id[field_id]["page"] = page_index + 1
                field_info_by_id[field_id]["rect"] = [float(x) for x in ann.get("/Rect")]
            elif field_id in possible_radio_names:
                try:
                    on_values = [v for v in ann["/AP"]["/N"] if v != "/Off"]
                except KeyError:
                    continue
                if len(on_values) == 1:
                    rect = [float(x) for x in ann.get("/Rect")]
                    radio = radio_fields_by_id.setdefault(field_id, {
                        "field_id": field_id, "type": "radio_group",
                        "page": page_index + 1, "radio_options": []})
                    # macOS Preview may not display selected radio buttons; Chrome/Firefox/Acrobat do.
                    radio["radio_options"].append({"value": on_values[0], "rect": rect})

    # Some PDFs define fields without annotations, so their location is unknown; ignore them.
    located = []
    for info in field_info_by_id.values():
        if "page" in info:
            located.append(info)
        else:
            print(f"Unable to determine location for field id: {info.get('field_id')}, ignoring")

    def sort_key(f):
        rect = (f["radio_options"][0]["rect"] if "radio_options" in f else f.get("rect")) or [0, 0, 0, 0]
        return [f.get("page"), [-rect[1], rect[0]]]

    out = located + list(radio_fields_by_id.values())
    out.sort(key=sort_key)
    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- check
def cmd_check(a):
    reader = open_reader(a.pdf)
    fields = reader.get_fields() or {}
    acro = reader.trailer["/Root"].get("/AcroForm")
    acro = acro.get_object() if acro else {}
    names = list(fields)
    form_id = None
    if any(n.startswith("SC-100[0]") for n in names):
        form_id = "SC-100"
    summary = {
        "fillable": bool(fields),
        "field_count": sum(1 for f in fields.values() if not f.get("/Kids")),
        "pages": len(reader.pages),
        "encrypted": PdfReader(a.pdf).is_encrypted,
        "has_xfa": "/XFA" in acro,
        "form_id": form_id,
    }
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    if fields:
        print("This PDF has fillable form fields")
    else:
        print("This PDF does not have fillable form fields; you will need to visually determine where to enter data")


def cmd_extract(a):
    info = get_field_info(open_reader(a.pdf))
    with open(a.out, "w") as f:
        json.dump(info, f, indent=2)
    print(f"Wrote {len(info)} fields to {a.out}")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ render
def cmd_render(a):
    os.makedirs(a.out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        from pdf2image import convert_from_path
        images = convert_from_path(a.pdf, dpi=200)
    except ImportError:
        if not shutil.which("pdftoppm"):
            sys.exit("ERROR: need pdf2image (pip) or pdftoppm (poppler-utils) to render pages")
        from PIL import Image
        tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        subprocess.run(["pdftoppm", "-png", "-r", "200", a.pdf, os.path.join(tmp, "p")], check=True)
        images = [Image.open(os.path.join(tmp, n)) for n in sorted(os.listdir(tmp))]
    for i, image in enumerate(images):
        w, h = image.size
        if w > a.max_dim or h > a.max_dim:  # keep both sides under max_dim
            s = min(a.max_dim / w, a.max_dim / h)
            image = image.resize((int(w * s), int(h * s)))
        path = os.path.join(a.out_dir, f"page_{i + 1}.png")
        image.save(path)
        print(f"Saved page {i + 1} as {path} (size: {image.size})")
    print(f"Converted {len(images)} pages to PNG images")


# -------------------------------------------------------------------- fill
def validation_error_for_field_value(info, value):
    t, fid = info["type"], info["field_id"]
    if t == "pushbutton":
        return f'ERROR: "{fid}" is a push button (Print/Save/Reset); never set it'
    if t == "checkbox":
        c, u = info.get("checked_value"), info.get("unchecked_value")
        if value not in (c, u):
            return f'ERROR: Invalid value "{value}" for checkbox field "{fid}". The checked value is "{c}" and the unchecked value is "{u}"'
    elif t == "radio_group":
        opts = [o["value"] for o in info["radio_options"]]
        if value not in opts:
            return f'ERROR: Invalid value "{value}" for radio group field "{fid}". Valid values are: {opts}'
    elif t == "choice":
        opts = [o["value"] for o in info["choice_options"]]
        if value not in opts:
            return f'ERROR: Invalid value "{value}" for choice field "{fid}". Valid values are: {opts}'
    elif t == "text" and not isinstance(value, str):
        return f'ERROR: Text field "{fid}" needs a string value, got {type(value).__name__}'
    return None


def monkeypatch_pypdf_choice_bug():
    # pypdf (<= 5.7) joins /Opt for list-box fields, but /Opt can be [[value, text], ...],
    # which raises TypeError. Return only the value strings for that case.
    from pypdf.constants import FieldDictionaryAttributes
    from pypdf.generic import DictionaryObject
    original = DictionaryObject.get_inherited

    def patched(self, key, default=None):
        result = original(self, key, default)
        if key == FieldDictionaryAttributes.Opt and isinstance(result, list) and \
                all(isinstance(v, list) and len(v) == 2 for v in result):
            result = [r[0] for r in result]
        return result

    DictionaryObject.get_inherited = patched


def cmd_fill(a):
    monkeypatch_pypdf_choice_bug()
    with open(a.values) as f:
        fields = json.load(f)
    reader = open_reader(a.pdf)
    by_id = {f["field_id"]: f for f in get_field_info(reader)}
    has_error = False
    by_page = {}
    for field in fields:
        existing = by_id.get(field["field_id"])
        if not existing:
            has_error = True
            print(f"ERROR: `{field['field_id']}` is not a valid field ID")
            continue
        if field.get("page") != existing["page"]:
            has_error = True
            print(f"ERROR: Incorrect page number for `{field['field_id']}` (got {field.get('page')}, expected {existing['page']})")
            continue
        if "value" in field:
            err = validation_error_for_field_value(existing, field["value"])
            if err:
                has_error = True
                print(err)
                continue
            if existing.get("read_only"):
                print(f"NOTE: `{field['field_id']}` is read-only in the form (usually a mirror of another field); setting it anyway")
            by_page.setdefault(field["page"], {})[field["field_id"]] = field["value"]
    if has_error:
        print("No output written; fix the errors above and rerun.")
        sys.exit(1)

    writer = PdfWriter(clone_from=reader)
    for page, values in by_page.items():
        writer.update_page_form_field_values(writer.pages[page - 1], values, auto_regenerate=False)
    # Needed for many viewers to render the values; may trigger a "save changes" prompt.
    writer.set_need_appearances_writer(True)
    acro = writer._root_object.get("/AcroForm")
    if acro is not None and "/XFA" in acro.get_object() and not a.keep_xfa:
        # XFA-capable viewers (Acrobat) render the empty XFA data instead of the AcroForm values.
        del acro.get_object()["/XFA"]
        print("Removed the XFA layer so viewers show the filled AcroForm values")
    with open(a.out, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    print(f"Filled {sum(len(v) for v in by_page.values())} fields; wrote {a.out}")


def cmd_dump(a):
    reader = open_reader(a.pdf)
    fields = reader.get_fields() or {}
    n = 0
    for fid, f in fields.items():
        if f.get("/Kids"):
            continue
        v = f.get("/V")
        empty = v in (None, "", "/Off")
        if empty and not a.all:
            continue
        n += 1
        print(f"{fid} = {v!r}")
    print(f"{n} {'fields' if a.all else 'non-empty fields'}")


# ---------------------------------------------- non-fillable: bounding boxes
def get_bounding_box_messages(fields_json_stream):
    messages = []
    fields = json.load(fields_json_stream)
    messages.append(f"Read {len(fields['form_fields'])} fields")

    def intersect(r1, r2):
        disjoint_h = r1[0] >= r2[2] or r1[2] <= r2[0]
        disjoint_v = r1[1] >= r2[3] or r1[3] <= r2[1]
        return not (disjoint_h or disjoint_v)

    rects = []
    for f in fields["form_fields"]:
        rects.append((f["label_bounding_box"], "label", f))
        rects.append((f["entry_bounding_box"], "entry", f))
    has_error = False
    for i, (ri, ti, fi) in enumerate(rects):
        for rj, tj, fj in rects[i + 1:]:
            if fi["page_number"] == fj["page_number"] and intersect(ri, rj):
                has_error = True
                if fi is fj:
                    messages.append(f"FAILURE: intersection between label and entry bounding boxes for `{fi['description']}` ({ri}, {rj})")
                else:
                    messages.append(f"FAILURE: intersection between {ti} bounding box for `{fi['description']}` ({ri}) and {tj} bounding box for `{fj['description']}` ({rj})")
                if len(messages) >= 20:
                    messages.append("Aborting further checks; fix bounding boxes and try again")
                    return messages
        if ti == "entry" and "entry_text" in fi:
            font_size = fi["entry_text"].get("font_size", 14)
            height = ri[3] - ri[1]
            if height < font_size:
                has_error = True
                messages.append(f"FAILURE: entry bounding box height ({height}) for `{fi['description']}` is too short for the text content (font size: {font_size}). Increase the box height or decrease the font size.")
                if len(messages) >= 20:
                    messages.append("Aborting further checks; fix bounding boxes and try again")
                    return messages
    if not has_error:
        messages.append("SUCCESS: All bounding boxes are valid")
    return messages


def cmd_check_boxes(a):
    with open(a.fields) as f:
        msgs = get_bounding_box_messages(f)
    for m in msgs:
        print(m)
    if not msgs[-1].startswith("SUCCESS"):
        sys.exit(1)


def cmd_validation_image(a):
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    with open(a.fields) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    img = Image.open(a.in_png)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    n = 0
    for field in data["form_fields"]:
        if field["page_number"] == a.page:
            draw.rectangle(field["entry_bounding_box"], outline="red", width=2)
            draw.rectangle(field["label_bounding_box"], outline="blue", width=2)
            n += 2
    img.save(a.out_png)
    print(f"Created validation image at {a.out_png} with {n} bounding boxes")


def transform_coordinates(bbox, image_width, image_height, pdf_width, pdf_height):
    # Image: origin top-left, y down. PDF: origin bottom-left, y up.
    xs, ys = pdf_width / image_width, pdf_height / image_height
    return bbox[0] * xs, pdf_height - bbox[3] * ys, bbox[2] * xs, pdf_height - bbox[1] * ys


def cmd_annotate(a):
    from pypdf.annotations import FreeText
    with open(a.fields) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    reader = open_reader(a.pdf)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.append(reader)
    dims = {i + 1: [float(p.mediabox.width), float(p.mediabox.height)] for i, p in enumerate(reader.pages)}
    count = 0
    for field in data["form_fields"]:
        et = field.get("entry_text") or {}
        text = et.get("text")
        if not text:
            continue  # skip empty fields
        pn = field["page_number"]
        pinfo = next(p for p in data["pages"] if p["page_number"] == pn)
        rect = transform_coordinates(field["entry_bounding_box"], pinfo["image_width"], pinfo["image_height"], *dims[pn])
        # Font size/color is not honored by every viewer (pypdf issue #2084).
        ann = FreeText(text=text, rect=rect, font=et.get("font", "Arial"),
                       font_size=f"{et.get('font_size', 14)}pt", font_color=et.get("font_color", "000000"),
                       border_color=None, background_color=None)
        writer.add_annotation(page_number=pn - 1, annotation=ann)
        count += 1
    with open(a.out, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    print(f"Successfully filled PDF form and saved to {a.out}")
    print(f"Added {count} text annotations")


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sp = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
